tools.description: Read Kazee agent workflow, styling, React/Vue differences, Toast lifecycle, or dashboard application-composition boundaries.

instructions: Read-only, offline Kazee Design System reference for React/Vue. Start with get_catalog_versions. Use exact installed package versions. A -workspace selector is only for explicitly reviewing this unpublished checkout or matching local packed artifacts; it is not a registry installation version. Request public docs/examples before implementation; do not scan dependency internals. Release candidates are explicitly marked and do not prove registry publication. Documentation tools never install, modify files, execute commands, read credentials or inspect your project.
